notes.title: Update Notes for Oct 16
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fleshed out Practice Area
[*]Implemented more pushback on successful hit
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Oct 16th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Two new maps
[*] Powerups tweaked to be more powerful
[*] Gameplay rebalancing
[*] Further localization support
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for September 29
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added heart glasses
[*] Added Froggie headgear
[*] Tweaked pushback to seals
[*] Enlarged Bento Map
[*] Tightened play area in Overflow Map
[*] Simplified Shader
[*] Fixed Don in Survival mode so he takes in any interactable in exchange for food for the pups
[*] Updated localization strings
[*] Added auto multiball in pinball mode for 1P+ modes
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for September 9 2022
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Reduced multi jump into double jump and increased cooldown
[*]Fixed collision errors in Last Stand Map
[*]Ice cubes now respawn in Iceberg Map
[*]Fixed bug where score in Puck mode would not track properly if in a team
[*]Reduced jump sfx volume
[*]Shortened default round time for Control Mode
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for September 6th
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added UI Improvements
[*]Fixed a bug that would allow a solo player to launch 2P+ playlists
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the player to shuffle pick maps that are not compatible with the party settings
[*]Survival mode tweaks
[*]Fixed a bug that would make the control mappings not accessible via the pause menu
[*]Fixed controller settings not being saved if user configured
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for September 2nd
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added a shuffle pick button for "A la Carte" page
[*]Fixed struggling out of a stun lock being too easy
[*]Fixed Team Stats not updating in Sumo Mode when playing in Teams
[*]Tuned the blocks in Smash mode to contrast with background and provide better visibility
[*]Added ability to move seal pups around in Survival mode to add a new level of complexity
[*]Seal pups now destroy the rest of the grime if they get too stressed
[*]Added a few new cosmetic items
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for August 24th
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Players can now change the name tag when customizing their seals
[*]Fixed a bug in Smash mode that would result in the round playing endlessly
[*]Fixed mystery items falling through the floor
[*]Fixed player portraits going blank after a rematch
[*]Relocated controls to be under options
[*]Added display settings under options
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for August 19 2022
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug that would play a previous playlist instead of custom picks selected by the player via A La Carte if a playlist had already been played before.
[*] Added playlist description to make the choices clearer to the player
[*] Added UI refinements and fixes
[/olist]

notes.title: Update notes for August 18 2022
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where player would not be able to access tutorial if a playlist had been launched beforehand
[/olist]

notes.title: Update notes for August 1st 2022
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Players can now interact with the UI with the mouse
[*]Fixed a bug in the tutorial causing the flow to break if Tempura gets thrown off the arena with the puffer fish powerup
[*]Added temporary solution for controller remapping
[/list]
